checks.statement: The lambda-zero logarithmic derivative obeys the Riccati identity.
The scale-invariant sensitivity obeys h_Q=2 g h-A_lambda.
The forced Wronskian derivative has the declared A_lambda u^2 sign.
The integrating-factor identity is (u^2 h)_Q=-A_lambda u^2.
h is invariant under a differentiable amplitude rescaling of the recessive direction.
The Q-to-x measure factor is C^(-1/2) sqrt(x) dx.
Scaled Bessel K cancels the common exponential scale in the h integrand.
The leading h scale grows as exp(Q/2)/2, so h(infinity) is not set to zero.
The manual exponential tail majorant has the declared antiderivative.
